content.title: Ad group WPP names Ogilvy chief Devika Bulchandani as COO
content.summary: Advertising group WPP Plc named insider Devika Bulchandani as its chief operating officer on Friday, days after announcing the year-end retirement of Andrew Scott. Laurent Ezekiel will replace Bulchandani as the global CEO of WPP's advertising agency Oglivy. WPP's boss, Cindy Rose, who took over from Mark Read in July, is overhauling operations at the company, which lost its crown as the world's biggest ad group to France's Publicis last year.
